package learningplanner

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestCreateOnboardingPlanHandoffUsesDedicatedStrictContract(t *testing.T) {
	intent := handoffClientIntent(t)
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
		require.Equal(t, http.MethodPost, request.Method)
		require.Equal(t, "/internal/students/"+readinessStudentID+"/onboarding-plan-handoffs", request.URL.Path)
		require.Equal(t, "handoff-secret", request.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token"))
		require.Equal(t, intent.CommandID, request.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key"))
		var body map[string]any
		require.NoError(t, json.NewDecoder(request.Body).Decode(&body))
		require.Equal(t, map[string]any{
			"schema":             "teacher-onboarding-plan-handoff-request.v1",
			"expected_state_ref": map[string]any{"kind": "accepted_draft", "version": float64(4)},
			"dialog_id":          intent.DialogID, "teacher_job_id": intent.CommandTeacherJobID,
		}, body)
		for _, forbidden := range []string{"profile", "desired_stacks", "graph", "goal", "course_id", "learning_path_id"} {
			require.NotContains(t, body, forbidden)
		}
		writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		writer.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated)
		_, _ = writer.Write([]byte(`{"schema":"teacher-onboarding-plan-handoff.v1","handoff_id":"66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666","status":"ACCEPTED","state_ref":{"kind":"accepted_draft","version":4},"goal":{"code":"programming.foundation","version":"v1","graph_version":"programming-foundation-graph-v1"},"execution_status":"NOT_STARTED","content_status":"NOT_CREATED","readiness_observed_at":"2026-09-11T10:00:00Z","replayed":false}`))
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "readiness-secret", HandoffToken: "handoff-secret", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	result, err := client.CreateOnboardingPlanHandoff(context.Background(), intent)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666", result.HandoffID)
	require.Equal(t, "2026-09-11T10:00:00Z", result.ReadinessObservedAt)
}

func TestCreateOnboardingPlanHandoffParsesExactConflictCodes(t *testing.T) {
	for _, testCase := range []struct {
		name, body string
		want       error
	}{
		{name: "active path", body: `{"error":{"code":"active_path_exists"}}`, want: domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffActivePath},
		{name: "state changed", body: `{"error":{"code":"state_changed"}}`, want: domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffStateChanged},
		{name: "idempotency", body: `{"error":{"code":"idempotency_conflict"}}`, want: domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffConflict},
		{name: "unknown", body: `{"error":{"code":"future_conflict"}}`, want: domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffInvalidResponse},
		{name: "malformed", body: `{"error":{"code":"state_changed"},"extra":true}`, want: domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffInvalidResponse},
	} {
		t.Run(testCase.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
				writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
				writer.WriteHeader(http.StatusConflict)
				_, _ = writer.Write([]byte(testCase.body))
			}))
			defer server.Close()
			intent := handoffClientIntent(t)
			client := Client{BaseURL: server.URL, HandoffToken: "handoff-secret", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
			_, err := client.CreateOnboardingPlanHandoff(context.Background(), intent)
			require.ErrorIs(t, err, testCase.want)
		})
	}
}

func TestCreateOnboardingPlanHandoffStrictlyParsesStructuralErrors(t *testing.T) {
	for _, testCase := range []struct {
		name, contentType, body string
		status                  int
		want                    error
	}{
		{name: "known bad student", status: http.StatusBadRequest, contentType: "application/json", body: `{"error":{"code":"invalid_student_id"}}`, want: domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffRejected},
		{name: "known not ready", status: http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, contentType: "application/json", body: `{"error":{"code":"not_ready"}}`, want: domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffRejected},
		{name: "unknown 422", status: http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, contentType: "application/json", body: `{"error":{"code":"future_rejection"}}`, want: domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffInvalidResponse},
		{name: "wrong status for known code", status: http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, contentType: "application/json", body: `{"error":{"code":"state_changed"}}`, want: domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffInvalidResponse},
		{name: "wrong content type", status: http.StatusConflict, contentType: "text/plain", body: `{"error":{"code":"state_changed"}}`, want: domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffInvalidResponse},
		{name: "trailing JSON", status: http.StatusConflict, contentType: "application/json", body: `{"error":{"code":"state_changed"}} {}`, want: domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffInvalidResponse},
		{name: "oversized", status: http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, contentType: "application/json", body: strings.Repeat("x", maximumHandoffResponseBytes+1), want: domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffInvalidResponse},
	} {
		t.Run(testCase.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
				writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", testCase.contentType)
				writer.WriteHeader(testCase.status)
				_, _ = writer.Write([]byte(testCase.body))
			}))
			defer server.Close()
			client := Client{BaseURL: server.URL, HandoffToken: "handoff-secret", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
			_, err := client.CreateOnboardingPlanHandoff(context.Background(), handoffClientIntent(t))
			require.ErrorIs(t, err, testCase.want)
		})
	}
}

func TestCreateOnboardingPlanHandoffRejectsMalformedSuccess(t *testing.T) {
	for _, body := range []string{
		`{"schema":"teacher-onboarding-plan-handoff.v1","handoff_id":"66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666","status":"ACCEPTED","state_ref":{"kind":"accepted_draft","version":4},"goal":{"code":"programming.foundation","version":"v1","graph_version":"programming-foundation-graph-v1"},"execution_status":"NOT_STARTED","content_status":"NOT_CREATED","replayed":false}`,
		`{"schema":"teacher-onboarding-plan-handoff.v1","handoff_id":"66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666","status":"ACCEPTED","state_ref":{"kind":"accepted_draft","version":4},"goal":{"code":"programming.foundation","version":"v1","graph_version":"programming-foundation-graph-v1"},"execution_status":"NOT_STARTED","content_status":"NOT_CREATED","readiness_observed_at":"2026-09-11T12:00:00+02:00","replayed":false}`,
		`{"schema":"teacher-onboarding-plan-handoff.v1","handoff_id":"66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666","status":"ACCEPTED","state_ref":{"kind":"accepted_draft","version":4},"goal":{"code":"programming.foundation","version":"v1","graph_version":"programming-foundation-graph-v1"},"execution_status":"NOT_STARTED","content_status":"NOT_CREATED","readiness_observed_at":"2026-09-11T10:00:00Z","replayed":false,"path_id":"77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777"}`,
		`{"schema":"teacher-onboarding-plan-handoff.v1","handoff_id":"66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666","status":"ACCEPTED","state_ref":{"kind":"accepted_draft","version":4},"goal":{"code":"programming.foundation","version":"v1","graph_version":"programming-foundation-graph-v1"},"execution_status":"NOT_STARTED","content_status":"NOT_CREATED","readiness_observed_at":"2026-09-11T10:00:00Z"}`,
		`{"schema":"teacher-onboarding-plan-handoff.v1","handoff_id":"66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666","status":"ACCEPTED","state_ref":{"kind":"accepted_draft","version":4},"goal":{"code":"programming.foundation","version":"v1","graph_version":"programming-foundation-graph-v1"},"execution_status":"NOT_STARTED","content_status":"NOT_CREATED","readiness_observed_at":"2026-09-11T10:00:00Z","replayed":null}`,
	} {
		server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
			writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
			writer.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated)
			_, _ = writer.Write([]byte(body))
		}))
		intent := handoffClientIntent(t)
		client := Client{BaseURL: server.URL, HandoffToken: "handoff-secret", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
		_, err := client.CreateOnboardingPlanHandoff(context.Background(), intent)
		require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffInvalidResponse)
		server.Close()
	}
}

func TestCreateOnboardingPlanHandoffRequiresReplayStatusCoupling(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
		writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		writer.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
		_, _ = writer.Write([]byte(`{"schema":"teacher-onboarding-plan-handoff.v1","handoff_id":"66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666","status":"ACCEPTED","state_ref":{"kind":"accepted_draft","version":4},"goal":{"code":"programming.foundation","version":"v1","graph_version":"programming-foundation-graph-v1"},"execution_status":"NOT_STARTED","content_status":"NOT_CREATED","readiness_observed_at":"2026-09-11T10:00:00Z","replayed":false}`))
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := Client{BaseURL: server.URL, HandoffToken: "handoff-secret", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	_, err := client.CreateOnboardingPlanHandoff(context.Background(), handoffClientIntent(t))
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffInvalidResponse)
}

func handoffClientIntent(t *testing.T) domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent {
	t.Helper()
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 11, 9, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	intent, err := domain.BuildTeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent(
		domain.PersonalTeacher{ID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", StudentID: readinessStudentID},
		domain.TeacherDialogBinding{ID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", StudentID: readinessStudentID, PersonalTeacherID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", ContextType: domain.LearningContextGeneral},
		domain.TeacherLearningReadiness{Schema: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessSchema, Result: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessReady,
			ReasonCodes: []string{domain.TeacherReadinessReasonFoundationGraphResolved}, ResolverVersion: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessResolver,
			StateRef: domain.TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef{Kind: domain.TeacherReadinessStateDraft, Version: 4}, ReadinessScope: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessScope,
			ContentStatus: domain.TeacherLearningContentNotCreated, Goal: &domain.TeacherLearningReadinessGoal{Code: domain.TeacherFoundationGoalCode, Version: domain.TeacherFoundationGoalVersion, GraphVersion: domain.TeacherFoundationGraphVersion}},
		"ru", "", "", now,
	)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	intent.Status, intent.ClaimToken, intent.LockedBy, intent.LockedUntil, intent.Attempts = domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffDispatching, "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", "worker", now.Add(time.Minute), 1
	intent, err = domain.NewTeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent(intent)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	return intent
}

const readinessStudentID = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"

func TestResolveLearningReadinessUsesExactFencedReadOnlyContract(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
		require.Equal(t, http.MethodPost, request.Method)
		require.Equal(t, "/internal/students/"+readinessStudentID+"/learning-readiness", request.URL.Path)
		require.Equal(t, "teacher-secret", request.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token"))
		require.Empty(t, request.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key"))
		var body map[string]any
		require.NoError(t, json.NewDecoder(request.Body).Decode(&body))
		require.Equal(t, "learning-readiness-request.v1", body["schema"])
		require.Equal(t, map[string]any{"kind": "accepted_draft", "version": float64(4)}, body["expected_state_ref"])
		for _, forbidden := range []string{"profile", "goal", "graph", "desired_stacks", "mastery", "active_path"} {
			require.NotContains(t, body, forbidden)
		}
		writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
		_, _ = writer.Write([]byte(`{"schema":"learning-readiness.v1","result":"READY","reason_codes":["FOUNDATION_GRAPH_RESOLVED"],"resolver_version":"learning-readiness-resolver-v1","state_ref":{"kind":"accepted_draft","version":4},"readiness_scope":"PUBLISHED_GRAPH_RESOLUTION","executable":false,"content_status":"NOT_CREATED","goal":{"code":"programming.foundation","version":"v1","graph_version":"programming-foundation-graph-v1"}}`))
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "teacher-secret", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	result, err := client.ResolveLearningReadiness(context.Background(), readinessStudentID, domain.TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef{Kind: "accepted_draft", Version: 4})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherFoundationGoalCode, result.Goal.Code)
}

func TestResolveLearningReadinessRejectsStaleOperationalAndMalformedResults(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name        string
		status      int
		contentType string
		body        string
		wantStale   bool
	}{
		{name: "stale", status: http.StatusConflict, contentType: "application/json", body: `{}`, wantStale: true},
		{name: "planner 5xx", status: http.StatusServiceUnavailable, contentType: "application/json", body: `{}`},
		{name: "planner 422", status: http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, contentType: "application/json", body: `{}`},
		{name: "wrong content type", status: http.StatusOK, contentType: "text/plain", body: `{}`},
		{name: "unknown field", status: http.StatusOK, contentType: "application/json", body: `{"unexpected":true}`},
		{name: "wrong state ref", status: http.StatusOK, contentType: "application/json", body: `{"schema":"learning-readiness.v1","result":"NEEDS_CLARIFICATION","reason_codes":["PROFILE_INCOMPLETE"],"resolver_version":"learning-readiness-resolver-v1","state_ref":{"kind":"accepted_draft","version":5},"readiness_scope":"PUBLISHED_GRAPH_RESOLUTION","executable":false,"content_status":"NOT_CREATED"}`, wantStale: true},
		{name: "impossible result reason", status: http.StatusOK, contentType: "application/json", body: `{"schema":"learning-readiness.v1","result":"READY","reason_codes":["PROFILE_INCOMPLETE"],"resolver_version":"learning-readiness-resolver-v1","state_ref":{"kind":"accepted_draft","version":4},"readiness_scope":"PUBLISHED_GRAPH_RESOLUTION","executable":false,"content_status":"NOT_CREATED"}`},
		{name: "oversized", status: http.StatusOK, contentType: "application/json", body: strings.Repeat("x", maximumReadinessResponseBytes+1)},
	}
	for _, testCase := range tests {
		t.Run(testCase.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
				writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", testCase.contentType)
				writer.WriteHeader(testCase.status)
				_, _ = writer.Write([]byte(testCase.body))
			}))
			defer server.Close()
			client := Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "teacher-secret", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
			_, err := client.ResolveLearningReadiness(context.Background(), readinessStudentID, domain.TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef{Kind: "accepted_draft", Version: 4})
			if testCase.wantStale {
				require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrTeacherLearningReadinessStale)
			} else {
				require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrTeacherLearningReadinessUnavailable)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestCreateCoursePlanDelegatesIntentWithoutMasteryOrPath(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
		require.Equal(t, "/internal/students/11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/course-plans", request.URL.Path)
		require.Equal(t, "teacher-secret", request.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token"))
		require.Equal(t, "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", request.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key"))
		var body map[string]any
		require.NoError(t, json.NewDecoder(request.Body).Decode(&body))
		require.Equal(t, "go.backend", body["goal_code"])
		require.Equal(t, "Build a Go API", body["desired_outcome"])
		require.NotContains(t, body, "mastery")
		require.NotContains(t, body, "learning_path")
		writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		writer.WriteHeader(http.StatusAccepted)
		_, _ = writer.Write([]byte(`{"request_id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333","goal_code":"go.backend","status":"PLANNING","reused":false,"attempts":0,"created_at":"2026-09-05T10:00:00Z","updated_at":"2026-09-05T10:00:00Z","source":"TEACHER","reason":"INITIAL"}`))
	}))
	defer server.Close()

	client := Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "teacher-secret", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	result, err := client.CreateCoursePlan(context.Background(), curriculum.PlanInput{
		StudentID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", IdempotencyKey: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		GoalCode: "go.backend", DesiredOutcome: "Build a Go API",
		Targets:     []domain.LearningTargetRef{{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.http", Version: "v1"}},
		Constraints: curriculum.PlanConstraints{Language: "ru", WeeklyMinutes: 180},
		AuditRefs:   curriculum.PlanAuditRefs{DialogID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"},
		Reason:      curriculum.PlanReasonInitial,
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", result.RequestID)
	require.Equal(t, "PLANNING", result.Status)
}

func TestCreateCoursePlanRejectsResponseContractDrift(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
		writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_, _ = writer.Write([]byte(`{"request_id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333","goal_code":"go.backend","status":"PLANNING","reused":false,"attempts":0,"created_at":"2026-09-05T10:00:00Z","updated_at":"2026-09-05T10:00:00Z","source":"TEACHER","reason":"INITIAL","unexpected":true}`))
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "teacher-secret", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	_, err := client.CreateCoursePlan(context.Background(), curriculum.PlanInput{
		StudentID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", IdempotencyKey: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		GoalCode: "go.backend", DesiredOutcome: "Build a Go API", Reason: curriculum.PlanReasonInitial,
	})
	require.Error(t, err)
}

func TestCreateCoursePlanAcceptsCanonicalTerminalReplays(t *testing.T) {
	for _, status := range []string{"COMPLETED", "FAILED"} {
		t.Run(status, func(t *testing.T) {
			server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
				writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
				if status == "COMPLETED" {
					_, _ = writer.Write([]byte(`{"request_id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333","goal_code":"go.backend","status":"COMPLETED","result_code":"COURSE_REUSED","course_id":"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444","learning_path_id":"66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666","reused":true,"attempts":2,"created_at":"2026-09-05T10:00:00Z","updated_at":"2026-09-05T10:02:00Z","completed_at":"2026-09-05T10:02:00Z","source":"TEACHER","reason":"INITIAL"}`))
					return
				}
				_, _ = writer.Write([]byte(`{"request_id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333","goal_code":"go.backend","status":"FAILED","reused":false,"attempts":2,"created_at":"2026-09-05T10:00:00Z","updated_at":"2026-09-05T10:02:00Z","completed_at":"2026-09-05T10:02:00Z","source":"TEACHER","reason":"INITIAL"}`))
			}))
			defer server.Close()
			client := Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "teacher-secret", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
			result, err := client.CreateCoursePlan(context.Background(), curriculum.PlanInput{
				StudentID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", IdempotencyKey: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", GoalCode: "go.backend", DesiredOutcome: "Build a Go API", Reason: curriculum.PlanReasonInitial,
			})
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.Equal(t, status, result.Status)
			if status == "COMPLETED" {
				require.Equal(t, "COURSE_REUSED", result.ResultCode)
				require.Equal(t, "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", result.CourseID)
				require.True(t, result.Reused)
			}
		})
	}
}
